event_text: Teams begin working to restore services, after abnormal activity with illicit access is seen overnight
notes: L'Echo touristique: teams at work 'since Friday at 5 AM'.

event_text: TourMaG publishes that many travel sites are down and quotes the company's president on the cyberattack
The company's president says services are being brought back gradually
Gradual restoration of customer platforms begins
notes: As told to L'Echo touristique on Saturday morning.
